categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the high-performance composite materials sector, focusing on ePTFE microporous products, CMD and gas management products, SiO2 aerogel products, and high-performance wiring harness products. It also maintains traditional businesses including water-blocking membranes, sealing parts, and sound absorption products. These products serve industries such as automotive, consumer electronics, aerospace, new energy, and medical fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary technologies covering the entire ePTFE membrane production chain including manufacturing, modification, composite, and component application. It has developed 10 core technologies including ePTFE membrane manufacturing, modification, composite technology, uniform fiber net laying, and high-performance desiccant production. The company also innovates in CMD technology for condensation management and integrates SiO2 aerogel with ePTFE membranes to enhance material properties. Production is mainly self-operated with some outsourcing for simpler processes, and the company invests in intelligent and automated manufacturing equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic joint venture and independent automotive manufacturers, automotive lighting companies, and new energy battery manufacturers. The company also serves consumer electronics, aerospace, medical, and packaging sectors. Major customers include Changzhou Xingyu Automotive Lighting Co., Ltd., Nanning Liaowang Automotive Lighting Co., Ltd., Shanghai Automotive Group Co., Ltd., Dalian Shipbuilding Industry Group Co., Ltd., and Funeng Technology (Ganzhou) Co., Ltd.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with domestic sales accounting for the majority of revenue. It also has export sales to overseas markets, though these constitute a smaller portion of total revenue. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing advanced composite materials and components such as ePTFE membranes and related products. It supplies these materials and components to downstream manufacturers in automotive, electronics, aerospace, and other industries. It also engages in some upstream activities by developing proprietary production equipment and technologies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation and R&D investment, focusing on expanding product applications and enhancing core technologies in ePTFE membranes, CMD, aerogel composites, and wiring harnesses. It collaborates with universities and research institutes, recruits high-end talent, and maintains a CNAS-accredited laboratory. Key R&D projects include multi-layer composite films for disposable bioreactors, rapid drainage valves for power battery packs, high-frequency low-loss automotive Ethernet wiring, and flexible copper-clad laminates for high-frequency digital transmission.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-performance composite materials and components, including ePTFE microporous products, CMD and gas management products, aerogel products, and wiring harnesses. The company mainly uses a direct sales model supplemented by some distribution channels. It also earns income from leasing properties and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few domestic enterprises that have overcome multiple technological barriers to independently manufacture various ePTFE membranes and components, competing against international giants like W. L. Gore & Associates (USA), Nitto Denko (Japan), and Donaldson. It leads the domestic market in ePTFE membrane technology and has taken a pioneering role in drafting national industry standards. The company is recognized as a national 'specialized and new' small giant and manufacturing 'single champion'.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 514.78 million, representing a 25.39% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 99.16 million, up 14.58%. Total assets reached RMB 1.09 billion, growing 14.23% from the previous year. The company maintains a healthy cash flow with operating cash inflows increasing by 57.55%. R&D investment accounted for 5.56% of revenue, reflecting a steady growth trajectory and commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly specialized, customizable ePTFE microporous membranes and composite materials with superior properties such as high chemical stability, temperature resistance, and precise micro-porosity. Its CMD products provide innovative condensation management solutions with patented technology that reduces manufacturing complexity and cost. The integration of SiO2 aerogel with ePTFE membranes enhances material performance and application scope. The company emphasizes domestic innovation and import substitution, providing high-quality, cost-effective alternatives to foreign products with strong technical support and customer service.
